description: Returns KeepMD's step-by-step guide, red flags and links to official consumer resources for reading an Explanation of Benefits (overview), resolving a bill that looks wrong (dispute), appealing a denial (appeal), or the handful of terms that drive the arithmetic (glossary). Use it when a user asks how to read an EOB, what to do about a bill that looks wrong, or how to appeal a denial.
